title.en: Should a pocket i stay silent or send an uncertain candidate?
title.ru: Должен ли pocket i молчать или отправить сомнительного кандидата?

hypothesis.en: A recall-first or marked-candidate policy loses fewer useful records than the balanced threshold, while making its extra traffic visible for downstream acceptance.
hypothesis.ru: Порог с приоритетом полноты или помеченный кандидат теряет меньше полезных записей, чем сбалансированный порог, а лишний трафик остаётся видимым для будущей приёмки.

policies.rule: Choose the threshold that maximises F1 on calibration pairs.
Choose the threshold that maximises F2 on calibration pairs; recall weighs four times as much as precision.
Always offer the top-ranked permitted record. Mark it uncertain when its score is below the balanced threshold.

decision_rule: Prefer zero privacy failures, then the fewest missed useful sources. Extra candidates are recoverable but must be reported, never hidden.
not_tested: automatic evidence extraction from messy memory
